metadata.title: Triptorelin 11.25 mg Therapy – 12 weeks
metadata.indication: Locally advanced or metastatic hormone-dependent advanced prostate cancer.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain explicitly unassessed and never block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

action.message: Hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Confirm the reaction and exact formulation.

rules.explanation: Hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Confirm the reaction and exact formulation.

action.message: Assess QT-prolongation and torsades risk, interacting medicines and need for ECG/electrolyte review. This is a benefit-risk review, not an invented automatic QT stop threshold.

rules.explanation: Assess QT-prolongation and torsades risk, interacting medicines and need for ECG/electrolyte review. This is a benefit-risk review, not an invented automatic QT stop threshold.

action.message: Review glucose control and monitoring during androgen deprivation. No universal glucose dose-reduction threshold is supplied by this regimen.

rules.explanation: Review glucose control and monitoring during androgen deprivation. No universal glucose dose-reduction threshold is supplied by this regimen.

action.message: Address fracture risk, bone-health assessment, exercise, calcium and vitamin D according to individual need and local policy. Do not assume every patient needs a bone-metastasis-dose agent.

rules.explanation: Address fracture risk, bone-health assessment, exercise, calcium and vitamin D according to individual need and local policy. Do not assume every patient needs a bone-metastasis-dose agent.

action.message: Review pre-existing cardiovascular disease and modifiable risk factors before and during ADT.

rules.explanation: Review pre-existing cardiovascular disease and modifiable risk factors before and during ADT.

action.message: A previously documented permanent stop remains in force; recovered measurements do not authorise re-exposure.

source.scope_note: Implementation safety guard based on the cited exclusion, dosing or warning; not a verbatim NCCP numeric threshold.

rules.explanation: A previously documented permanent stop remains in force; recovered measurements do not authorise re-exposure.

action.message: Review symptoms, PSA, testosterone suppression, adherence/administration and the overall disease plan. Do not assume isolated PSA change mandates stopping ADT.

rules.explanation: Review symptoms, PSA, testosterone suppression, adherence/administration and the overall disease plan. Do not assume isolated PSA change mandates stopping ADT.

action.message: GnRH agonists can initially raise testosterone. Review flare risk, monitoring and need for a prescribed short anti-androgen course; do not apply a universal bicalutamide duration.

rules.explanation: GnRH agonists can initially raise testosterone. Review flare risk, monitoring and need for a prescribed short anti-androgen course; do not apply a universal bicalutamide duration.

action.message: This is a source caution, not a blanket contraindication. Review flare risk and the need for other urgent/local treatment; ADT alone is inadequate for an acute compressive emergency.

rules.explanation: This is a source caution, not a blanket contraindication. Review flare risk and the need for other urgent/local treatment; ADT alone is inadequate for an acute compressive emergency.

action.message: Urgent assessment for cord compression or obstruction. Do not delay emergency management for routine ADT administration; the treating team decides the hormone strategy.

source.scope_note: Implementation safety guard based on the cited exclusion, dosing or warning; not a verbatim NCCP numeric threshold.

rules.explanation: Urgent assessment for cord compression or obstruction. Do not delay emergency management for routine ADT administration; the treating team decides the hormone strategy.

action.message: Assess and treat mood symptoms promptly; severe depression may occur with hormone suppression.

rules.explanation: Assess and treat mood symptoms promptly; severe depression may occur with hormone suppression.

treatment.duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.schedule_summary: Triptorelin 11.25 mg is given every 12 weeks (84 days). The usual NCCP route is into a muscle; the source also permits injection under the skin for this formulation.
treatment.duration_text: Individual duration according to disease setting and treatment plan

regular: blood glucose and bone profile as clinically indicated

supportive_care.other: Calcium and vitamin D supplementation according to local policy.

indications.description: Treatment of locally advanced or metastatic hormone-dependent advanced prostate cancer.
